item.title: Messi, Mbappé, Ronaldo: this World Cup belongs to the superstars
item.description: "Get ready for the ultimate World Cup analysis. Tune in to our podcast as we dive into the thrilling performances of soccer's biggest superstars: Messi, Mbappé, and Ronaldo. Discover how these legends are shaping the tournament and making it one to remember."
